main_text.l: bus, cætcrisque priùs recitatis, dono ob-
tulit. Sic enim sentio, has partes omnes
trinis his tabulis ab Henrico donatas coa-
luisse paulatim in unam Præfecturam,
quam Gho[?] & Woltrecht nuncupamus,
earumque tribunalis sedem in urbe esse
collocatam. De Comitatu verò in eâdem
Drentiâ, qui Gozelonis Lotharingiæ Ducis
(is est, qui in Frisiâ & Hollandiâ res gessit,
& imperium aliquandiu tenuit) & altero
Vmbalaha dicto[?], qui Comitis Enobardi
fuisse perhibentur, & non tam Ecclesiæ,
quàm Episcopo ab eodem Rege aliquot
annis post donati sunt,ἐπιχω[?]. At hoc ex
his omnibus, & compluribus aliis eorum
temporum tabulis disco. tum morem fu-
isse, ut Pagus maius aliquid significaret
quàm Comitatus, pluresque Comitatus
Pago uno, ac prædia plura uno Comitatu
comprehenderentur: ita unam eandem-
que Drentiam, item Tuentiam, item
speciales Frisiæ regiones in plures tunc
fuisse Comitatus distinctas. Quod in
Frisiâ potissimum hæsit diutiusculè, uti est
à me alibi demonstratum. Dicebaturque Comes
vulgò in his oris, qui ab Impera-
tore

page.notes: The black-letter word in the text ("Gho") is doubtful; the second word ("Woltrecht") is clear. The Greek word after "sunt," is doubtful and may be misread. "dicto" is doubtful. The bracketed margin note is transcribed as printed, including its brackets. The last word "tore" was printed on the same line as the signature "D 5" and is read as the end of "Imperatore" split at the line end.
